origin: LTspice versions of the kicad_transistors circuits: schematics drawn by the maintainer or written from the KiCad netlists and reviewed by the maintainer, LTspice 26.1.1's -netlist exports of them, and variants of the exports, each changing one form
author: xdylanm
notes: Exported by LTspice 26.1.1 with -netlist, with Default Devices and Default Libraries off; the first comment line holds the absolute schematic path in the export and is replaced by the file name. A variant's first line says what it changes. Most files include jellybean.lib from openjellybean 0.5.0 (https://github.com/xdylanm/openjellybean, MIT), which is not copied here: the solver sweep runs them when OPENJELLYBEAN_LIB names that file. The local_models and subckt variants carry copied openjellybean model blocks with their notice.

.gitignore.note: Keeps LTspice run output out, as in contributed_examples (decision 0009).

bjt_emitter_follower.asc.note: Written from the KiCad netlist by the developer, then redrawn by the maintainer.

bjt_emitter_follower_2n3904.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.net with model names that start with a digit; derived by the developer.

bjt_emitter_follower_lib.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.net with a one-field .lib in place of the .include; derived by the developer.

bjt_emitter_follower_local_models.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.net with its models copied from openjellybean 0.5.0; derived by the developer.

bjt_emitter_follower_off_temp.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.net with off and temp=; derived by the developer.

bjt_emitter_follower_positional_area.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.net with a positional area on each BJT; derived by the developer.

bjt_emitter_follower_subckt.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.net with the transistors and their models in a .subckt; derived by the developer.

bjt_emitter_follower_substrate.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.net with the PNP substrate on the supply; derived by the developer.

bjt_emitter_follower_three_nodes.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.net with 3-node BJTs, as written by hand; derived by the developer.

cmos_discrete_xor.asc.note: Written from the KiCad netlist by the developer, with a label on each pin; reviewed by the maintainer.

cmos_discrete_xor_local_models.cir.note: cmos_discrete_xor.net with its models copied from openjellybean 0.5.0, BS250_OJ with pchan; derived by the developer.

cmos_discrete_xor_m_off.cir.note: cmos_discrete_xor.net with VDMOS m= and off; derived by the developer.

cmos_discrete_xor_three_nodes.cir.note: cmos_discrete_xor.net with 3-node VDMOS lines, the reference's form; derived by the developer.

cmos_xor.asc.note: Drawn by the maintainer in LTspice 26.1.1: the KiCad cmos_xor, with the inverter on B.

cmos_xor_continued.cir.note: cmos_xor.net with the parameters on + continuation lines; derived by the developer.

cmos_xor_geometry.cir.note: cmos_xor.net with ad, as, pd and ps; derived by the developer.

cmos_xor_geometry_upper.cir.note: cmos_xor.net with upper-case names and values, nrd and nrs; derived by the developer.

cmos_xor_off_ic.cir.note: cmos_xor.net with off, and IC=vds,vgs,vbs with uic; derived by the developer.

edges.asc.note: Written from the KiCad netlist by the developer, with a label on each pin; reviewed by the maintainer.

sample_and_hold.asc.note: Written from the KiCad netlist by the developer, with a label on each pin; reviewed by the maintainer.

sample_and_hold_jfet_area_off_temp.cir.note: sample_and_hold.net with a positional JFET area, off and temp=; derived by the developer.

sample_and_hold_pjf.cir.note: sample_and_hold.net with a P-channel JFET and the diode reversed; derived by the developer.
